request: 配置 MCU 时钟，外部晶振 16MHz，系统时钟 160MHz
config:
```yaml
Mcu:
  McuClockReferencePoint:
    - id: 0
      frequency: 16000000
      type: EXTERNAL_OSCILLATOR
  McuClockSetting:
    - id: 0
      name: DefaultClock
      McuClockReferencePoint:
        - id: 0
          divider: 1
          multiplier: 10
  McuModule:
    - id: 0
      name: MCU_0
      McuClockSetting: 0
```

request: 配置 MCU 复位原因检测和 boot 状态
config:
```yaml
Mcu:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
    reset_reason_detect: true
  McuInitStatus:
    boot_status: NORMAL_BOOT
    last_reset_reason: POWER_ON_RESET
```
